ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Describe the life cycle of a caterpillar.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture shows a cyclic process connected by arrows. On the right side near C, there are eggs, and below the eggs there is a small larva that has just hatched; continuing downward and leftward along the arrows, several gradually growing caterpillar stages can be seen, with B and A marked nearby; the position on the left marked E is a hanging pupa or chrysalis; the position at the top marked D is an adult butterfly. Reasoning: The question asks to describe the life cycle of a caterpillar/butterfly, so converting the stages in the picture into words in the order of the arrows is: starting from eggs, hatching into larvae/caterpillars, after the caterpillars grow up they become pupae, and finally emerge as butterflies, and the butterflies lay eggs again to form a cycle.
